guide.bcenchantments.title: Field Guide
guide.bcenchantments.open: Field Guide: refining, powers and combinations
guide.bcenchantments.refining.intro: Refine a weapon right here at the smithing table. Leave the template slot empty, put the weapon in the middle slot and pay in emeralds on the right.
guide.bcenchantments.refining.emeralds: Emeralds go in the right slot. A level takes what it needs and leaves the rest.
guide.bcenchantments.refining.blocks: Emerald blocks work too, nine emeralds each.
guide.bcenchantments.refining.levels: There are five levels, about 500 emeralds in all; each costs 60 to 140. Every level adds attack speed, up to +0.5 at level 5, and one small random boost: damage, critical chance or critical damage.
guide.bcenchantments.refining.tooltip: The weapon's tooltip shows its level and the emeralds paid toward the next one. At level 5 it says it is ready for a trim: see Trim Powers.
guide.bcenchantments.perks.intro: Powers come only from trims: every armor trim grants its own power on a weapon. Charging powers fill a bar under the crosshair as you land hits and fire when it is full; the rest work on every hit.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.lightning: Strikes the target with lightning at the end of a long combo.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.shockwave: After three swings that each hit a crowd, a shockwave flies out ahead.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.cold_edge: Hits slow their targets. Keep one chilled for three seconds and it freezes solid.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.uppercut: A sword's third swing, a spear's heavy thrust or a mace swung from the ground launches the target into the air.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.chains: Every hit charges it, more when a swing hits several enemies; the charge lasts 8 seconds. When full, nearby enemies and the target are rooted in place for 0.7 seconds.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.echo: Every fourth landed swing echoes: a moment later its targets are struck again. Echoes charge the other bars.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.wind_charged: Enemies you kill burst like a wind charge, hurting and pushing those around them.
guide.bcenchantments.trims.first: At refinement level 5: an armor trim template, the weapon and an echo shard. The weapon gains the trim's power at level 1. The template is used up.
guide.bcenchantments.trims.raise: Another template of the same trim, with no shard, raises the power to level 2, then 3.
guide.bcenchantments.trims.which: Every trim grants its own power.
guide.bcenchantments.combining.intro: Powers combine in pairs, in the order they were put on: the first with the second, the third with the fourth. A power already in a combination is locked out of every other. At the smithing table, hover the weapon to see what its next trim would make.
synergy.bcenchantments.chained_lightning: Instead of binding enemies, Chains strikes each of them with half-power lightning and roots them for half a second.
synergy.bcenchantments.charged_lightning: Lightning bursts like a wind charge where it strikes, knocking enemies back.
synergy.bcenchantments.updraft.desc: Uppercut sends you and the target straight up, you a block above it, while it hangs stunned. With a mace, your next swing in the air smashes as if from six blocks up.
synergy.bcenchantments.frost_burst.desc: Death bursts chill whatever they catch.
synergy.bcenchantments.resonance.desc: Every echo also sparks a quarter-power lightning bolt on its target.
synergy.bcenchantments.tempest.desc: The shockwave throws enemies much harder; one slammed into a wall takes knockback damage. A mace's smash also hurts enemies within 2.5 blocks of the impact for 30% of its damage.
synergy.bcenchantments.frenzy.desc: On a fully refined weapon, at its top attack speed, Echo strikes every third swing instead of every fourth.
synergy.bcenchantments.shatter.desc: Lightning deals 15% more damage to slowed enemies, and double to enemies frozen solid, which also chills those around them. Kills spread chill to up to 6 enemies nearby.
guide.bcenchantments.trims.shield: Shields take a trim too, with no refinement: a trim template, the shield and an echo shard. Only a few powers work on a shield, and only at one level.
guide.bcenchantments.shield.wind_charged: When the shield blocks a hit, a gust throws back everything in front of it at 30% of a wind charge's strength. Every 30 seconds.
guide.bcenchantments.shield.cold_edge: When the shield blocks a hit from up close, the attacker is chilled hard. Every 10 seconds.
refinement.bcenchantments.shield.wind_ch: Blocking releases a gust, every 30 s
refinement.bcenchantments.shield.cold_ed: Blocking chills the attacker, every 10 s
guide.bcenchantments.perk.gravity: Every hit pulls the enemies around the target toward it, gathering them for the next swing.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.momentum: Sprint for a moment, then land a swing within half a second: it throws its targets back hard. The run-up is spent, so break away and charge in again.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.rampaging: Killing a monster makes you attack faster for 4 seconds; every further kill refreshes it.
synergy.bcenchantments.singularity.desc: The shockwave drags the enemies beside its path into it.
synergy.bcenchantments.black_hole.desc: Every enemy Chains binds pulls the free enemies around it in.
synergy.bcenchantments.cyclone.desc: A kill draws the enemies around it in before its wind burst goes off.
synergy.bcenchantments.launch.desc: A launching swing after a run-up throws its targets higher, and you go up after them.
synergy.bcenchantments.blast_step.desc: A kill by a swing after a run-up bursts you onward, into the next enemy.

tooltip.bcenchantments.combine.title: Next trim combines:
guide.bcenchantments.trims.combine: A different trim and an echo shard add another power, for experience levels: 20 for the second, 10 more for each after. A weapon holds any number of powers.
